title: The Arab Kingmaker in Israel’s Election Who Wants a Partnership With Jews
summary: Mansour Abbas, a dentist-turned-lawmaker, helped oust Benjamin Netanyahu once before. Now, he and a Jewish ex-police commander have teamed up to try to do it again.
